beats.t: The next morning, in the corridor at the edge of the market, Museong tucked a golden feather behind Moka's ear. Moka left it there.
See you at the sunrise stage. I'll sing with my eyes open this time.
You'll still get the notes wrong.
Yeah. So sit in the front row. Laugh louder than anyone.
Museong descended the cloud steps beneath the corridor. A few steps down, he turned and waved broadly. His voice was still hoarse.
That looks good behind your ear.
Shut up. I put it there because of the wind.
There isn't any wind.
There will be later. I'm ready in advance.
By that logic, you should carry an open umbrella before it rains.
Whoa, Neo made a joke. That was a joke, right?
Just an observation.
You're becoming quite talkative, Mr. Cat. An excellent sign for compatibility.
Enough about compatibility.
Yundal unfolded the natal chart. The Wu sector had cleared. But fine diagonal lines crossed the Xu sector like rain.
Xu. The Wealth Palace. The room of wealth. It's a little special in your chart, my lady. Your Body Palace is here.
Body Palace?
If the Life Palace is the face you're born with, the Body Palace is the room your body occupies. Your body lives in the room of wealth.
My body's a wallet?
Metaphorically. A place to hold what you receive. And a place to let it flow onward.
(A place to hold things. Museong said there was a vessel in the Wealth room.)
Yeoni glanced at their palm without thinking. Nothing was there. Yet a slender trail of rainwater seemed to pass between its lines.
Reaching the Xu gate at the palace's northwestern edge meant crossing a cloud valley. Rain began the moment they arrived at the valley.
This rain. It smells different.
(I know. It's the smell from the hallway on clear days.)
A sheet of paper clung to a wet rock. Yeoni peeled it off. Half the writing remained, blurred by rain.
[ Ledger · Eulhae Yeoni · Outstanding: 2 ]
A ledger page. Seo Hanbi's.
A few steps farther, another sheet. Then another. The pages lay scattered along the path, as though someone had dropped them deliberately.
She left a trail. While being dragged away.
Dragged away?
The same entry on every page. Outstanding: two. She tore out only your entries.
(There must have been so many others. Why mine?)
She's showing the way. Perhaps she wants us to find her. Or perhaps it's a warning to stay away.
I don't care which. We're following the pages.
Yeoni picked up the wet sheets one by one and slipped them into their notebook. The paper was cold. Rainwater soaked their fingertips.
As though in answer, a sound rose from below: chains scraping rock. Something heavy being dragged.
A black shape appeared in the mist below the valley. A huge beast with a striped back. Black chains wrapped its neck and forelegs.
...The tiger.
Hands gripped the ends of the chains. Dozens of black hands. They were dragging the tiger deeper into the mist.
Water pooled in every pawprint. A ledger page dropped onto each pool.
Seo Hanbi!
The tiger turned its head. Its red eyes found Yeoni through the mist. It moved its mouth without making a sound.
Don't come.
The hands jerked the chains. The tiger vanished into the mist. Only the rattling chains echoed for a long time.
Yeoni tried to leap into the valley, but Neo blocked the way. They grabbed his collar. He didn't retreat, but neither did he seize their wrist.
Move! They're dragging her away!
We can't see beneath the mist. If you fall too, I can't save you. Let's find another way.
She saved me. At the bus stop. In the hallway. I haven't repaid her even once.
Fire entered Yeoni's voice. Neo clenched his teeth. It hurt, but he didn't move away. He held his ground until Yeoni caught their breath.
I'll give you the chance to repay her. But we need to know the way. Those hands came from the Xu room.
Mr. Cat is right. The room with the vessel. Once we're there, we'll learn why she's being dragged away.
Beyond the Xu gate stood a vast hall. Rain poured through an opening in its rounded roof. Shallow pools covered the floor like mirrors.
An empty throne stood on a dais at the back. A violet star floated above it, shedding cool, clear light.
Zi Wei. Sovereign of the stars. In your chart, it holds Authority Transformation: the power to decide.
Beside the throne stood a small star that seemed to hold a seal. In a corner, a mass of mist crouched, swelling occasionally as though breathing.
The star with the seal is Tian Xiang. The mist in the corner is Tuo Luo, the star that drags things along. It delays things and holds you back.
(The star that drags. So the chains were coming from here.)
“You've come, child of Eul. I have waited long. Though there is nowhere for you to sit.”
Star, a tiger was dragged away earlier. Do you know where she went?
“I do. But first there is something you must see. At your feet.”
In the middle of the pool beneath the dais stood a huge vessel. Earth-colored and as tall as a person. Its interior was deep and dark.
Rain fell into it, but it never filled. Every drop vanished, as though it had no bottom.
“This is you. The vines of Eul Wood hold even the breath of others. That is why Black Moon calls you a vessel.”
What do you mean, hold?
“Black Moon has no body. Even after devouring the sky, it has nowhere to dwell. So it seeks something to contain it. An empty vessel, yet one that can hold anything.”
The darkness inside the vessel swirled. Scenes appeared within it: Yeoni sharing bread. Holding an umbrella over someone. Giving their last coin to a child.
(Things I gave away. But why are they all inside the vessel?)
“You are a giver. Giving is good. But Black Moon used that. It had your fortune collected from you. Giving emptied you; collection emptied you further.”
Had it collected? By whom?
The star didn't answer. Instead, a ledger page rose from the bottom of the vessel. A ledger densely filled with collected fortune. A familiar signature stood at the end. A name like rain.
The tiger collected your fortune on Black Moon's orders. That was what emptied you. Though she must have thought she was preventing it.
Preventing it? She took all my luck, and I spent the whole spring tripping and slipping.
Yes. That's true. The harm is still harm. But who gave her that ledger is also part of the truth.
(Every day I fell. Every day my umbrella blew inside out. She was writing another line in her ledger.)
Then Seo Hanbi was, from the start...
“Deceived. She took up the ledger to protect you, and that ledger emptied you. She still does not understand the calculation.”
Only rain could be heard. Yeoni laid a hand on the vessel's rim. It was cold. And utterly empty.
Then what should I do? Stop giving? To anyone, ever again?
“No. A vessel must be empty to hold something. Emptiness is not a sin.”
“The vessel decides what it holds. Not Black Moon.”
The violet star above the throne blinked once. A single ray fell into the vessel. A small character etched itself into the bottom: 權, Authority.
(The power to decide. The Authority Transformation in my chart. I decide whether to hold something.)
Did you hear? You decide.
Yes. I heard.
(I suppose I decide whether to forgive Seo Hanbi too. But I can't decide that yet.)
Star. I have to bring her back. I've got a mountain of questions for her. I'll decide whether to forgive her after that.
“That, too, is for the vessel to decide.”
My lady, you sounded very grown-up just now.
I am a grown-up. Twenty-three.
Then a sound came from the natal chart in Yundal's hands. The sound of glass cracking. The panel of eight characters floated up by itself.
[ Year: Im-o · Month: Byeong-o · Day: Eulhae · Hour: Gyeong-Chen ]
In the Hour sector, the character Gyeong flickered on and off like someone breathing unevenly.
Gyeong. Mr. Cat's place is wavering.
“A borrowed place cannot endure forever. That cat sits in your chart on borrowed terms. The day of repayment approaches.”
Repayment? Neo. What does that mean?
Just as Neo opened his mouth, his right hand turned transparent. The black stain faded with it. Rain passed straight through his palm.
...I'm still fine.
I told you nobody's allowed to say that! That's a fine! Ten skewers!
I'll pay. Later.
Tell me now, not later. What did you borrow, and when do you have to repay it?
Neo opened his mouth, then closed it. Color slowly returned to his hand. Yeoni didn't look away from it.
Outside the hall, the sky was moving. Twelve doors rotated slowly, the whole palace turning like a giant clock.
Hey, the sky's spinning. I'm getting motion sickness.
The palaces are becoming houses. Twelve palaces into twelve houses. The next sky is opening.
“Child of Eul. In the next sky, the stars have twelve houses. There, they call it by another name.”
It?
In the middle of the sky, a black circle appeared in the space between stars. It had the shape of a moon. But it gave no light. It swallowed light.
“The dark moon. That is what they call Black Moon there.”
Beneath the dark moon, chains sounded again, much farther away this time. Yeoni took out their notebook and added a final line: Seo Hanbi. Dragged away. Must find her.
